name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 54 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2026-07-17, at wavelengths from 0.91 to 4.68 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
